patch.description: Tour definitions live in frontend TypeScript. Backend stores per-user metadata. offer is throttled to 15 minutes after an offer/start and respects next_eligible_at and auto_start. Unanswered offer is eligible again after 24 hours; snooze interval defaults to 24 hours. Completed/skipped/in_progress cannot be offered automatically. Version rows are independent; global preference always applies.

document.description: Actual related receipt, null for manual stock operations; relation obeys organization scope.

operation_id.description: Stable client-generated UUID for retries. Reuse with a different payload or actor yields 409.

destination_warehouse_id.description: Required only for transfer, must differ from source.

quantity.description: Positive delta magnitude; for inventory the absolute counted quantity, including zero.

unit_price.description: Exact decimal string, not minor units and never a JSON float.

line_total.description: Exact decimal string, not minor units and never a JSON float.

total_amount.description: Exact decimal string, not minor units and never a JSON float.

request_id.description: Stable key for idempotent creation; keep it when retrying a lost response.

unit_price.description: Purchase price in major currency units, up to 9999999999.99.

PurchaseOrderPatch.description: Replaces the full draft, including all lines. Only draft orders may be edited.

request_id.description: Stable key for idempotent creation; keep it when retrying a lost response.

GoodsReceiptPatch.description: Replaces lines of an unconfirmed draft; purchase order cannot change.

TourProgressEvent.description: Only current user. No user_id, organization_id, client timestamps or status. Server assigns status and dates. Manual start bypasses automatic preference/cooldown.

ChecklistResponse.description: Live organization data, never inferred from training progress. Receipt requires a confirmed document; draft receipts do not count.

CreateOrganizationInput.description: Creates current user membership and activates new organization; slug is server assigned. Same key/name/membership retries return the existing organization.
